text: {"lessons":["Selling several stocks after gains and buying most of them back at higher prices taught me not to trade just to lock in a gain; I should have a clear reason for each trade.","My account value moved up and down while I mostly held, reminding me that short-term changes are normal and past price moves do not predict what comes next.","I should judge each position by its future prospects and my overall plan, not by its average cost or by how uncomfortable a loss feels."]}
